name: Seiyo (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Seiyo city emblem in blue: a ring open at the hoist enclosing the character 西.
history: Municipal flag of Seiyo, a city in Ehime Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 November 2004.

features.role: Seiyo city emblem — a ring open at the hoist enclosing the character 西
